The analysis failed due to incorrect margin calculations and formatting mismatches in the final summary report.
The test_rows_and_order failed with a value mismatch in the close() check (441.6 vs 5740.8). The test_totals_and_decision verifier failed because the calculated small kit margin (21496.81) did not match the expected value (-7106.39). Additionally, test_summary_requirements failed because the formatted string '21,496.81' was missing from the summary text, which used unformatted numbers like '21496.81'.
